en.title: US HUD tightens Fair Housing complaint deadline amid global accessibility pushes
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development has introduced a new deadline for filing Fair Housing Act accessibility complaints, aiming to streamline the process but raising concerns about reduced redress time for disability discrimination victims. In Taiwan, Yunlin’s Huwei township held CRPD-aligned leisure activities for disabled and elderly residents, while a Pingtung charity group distributed supplies and advocated for accessible toilets. Meanwhile, online shoppers still encounter accessibility barriers despite record back-to-school spending, and new research shows environmental barriers hinder aphasia participation, underscoring the need for inclusive design.

zh-TW.title: 美國HUD設定公平住房無障礙投訴新時限，台灣推動多元無障礙行動
zh-TW.summary: 美國住房與城市發展部（HUD）已設定公平住房法無障礙投訴的新截止日期，旨在簡化流程但引發對殘疾歧視受害者救濟時間縮短的擔憂。在台灣，海委會推出全臺16場無障礙親海體驗，雲林虎尾依據CRPD舉辦身障與長青體能休閒活動，屏東慈善團體則送米送物並倡導設置無障礙廁所。線上購物者仍遭遇無障礙障礙，研究顯示環境障礙阻礙失語症參與，凸顯提升數位與通用無障礙的必要性。
